tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on the SPI
tables.text: Table 462, "Effect of low-power modes on the SPI", in section 45.6 (SPI in low-power modes) on page 1976. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. Refer to Section45.3: SPI implementation for information about wake-up from Stop mode support per instance as well as Standby mode availability. If an instance is not functional in a Stop mode, it.

rows: No effect. SPI interrupts cause the device to exit Sleep mode.
The content of the SPI registers is kept.

The SPI instance is not functional in this mode. It is powered down, and must be 
reinitialized after exiting Standby mode.
notes: 1. Refer to Section45.3: SPI implementation for information about wake-up from Stop mode support per instance as well as Standby mode availability. If an instance is not functional in a Stop mode, it must be disabled before entering this Stop mode.
